items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: The transcript only contains the interviewer stating the interviewee's name is Lewis Isidall Bobrin and noting it is the same as his father's name. The interviewee does not describe a relationship with himself or another person named Lewis Isidall Bobrin.

ctx.x: Okay, we're interviewing today at 1722 New Orleans Street, that's right. Let's see, what's today's date, folks? 22nd. June the 22nd, 1960. And who are we interviewing? What's that mean? Lewis Bobrin. That's your full name? Lewis Isidall Bobrin.
Same as your father's name. My father's name, I think.
